1.  get rid of unknown values in race column

```{r}
data <- read.csv("../../../data/cleaning/null_demographics_removed.csv")
#check columns 
#head(data)
#check how many unknowns pre removing unknowns
#sum(data$susp_race == "UNKNOWN", na.rm = TRUE)

#remove unknowns 
data <- data[data$susp_race != "UNKNOWN", ]
sum(data$susp_race == "UNKNOWN", na.rm = TRUE)

data
```

2.  find top 20 precincts with the most crime counts (plotting it)

```{r}
#install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(precinct_crime), fill = time_period)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Incidents by Precinct (Top 20) and Time Period",
    x = "Precinct",
    y = "Number of Incidents",
    fill = "Time Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

3.  top 20 precincts, printing it

```{r}
library(dplyr)

top_precincts_table <- data %>%
  count(precinct_crime, sort = TRUE) %>%    # get top 20 by crime count
  slice_max(n, n = 20) %>%
  arrange(precinct_crime)                   # sort ascending

print(top_precincts_table)
```

# Running the T-Tests

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(purrr)

top20 <- c(40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 46, 47, 48, 52,
            67, 73, 75, 79, 81, 83, 103, 105, 113, 114, 115)

# Filter to top 20 precincts
df_top20 <- data %>% 
  filter(precinct_crime %in% top20) %>%
  filter(!susp_race %in% c("UNKNOWN", "(null)", "", NA))

# Get race categories
race_categories <- unique(df_top20$susp_race)

results <- map_dfr(race_categories, function(race_name){

  df_top20 %>%
    mutate(race_binary = as.numeric(susp_race == race_name)) %>%
    group_by(precinct_crime) %>%
    do({

      before_vals <- .$race_binary[.$time_period == "before Patternizr"]
      after_vals  <- .$race_binary[.$time_period == "after Patternizr"]

      n_before <- length(before_vals)
      n_after  <- length(after_vals)

      #sanity check dont need it obv 
      if(n_before < 2 | n_after < 2){
        # Not enough samples for t-test
        tibble(
          susp_race  = race_name,
          estimate   = NA,
          estimate1  = NA,
          estimate2  = NA,
          statistic  = NA,
          p.value    = NA,
          conf.low   = NA,
          conf.high  = NA,
          n_before   = n_before,
          n_after    = n_after
        )
      } else {
        t_out <- t.test(before_vals, after_vals)

        tibble(
          susp_race  = race_name,
          estimate   = t_out$estimate[2] - t_out$estimate[1],
          estimate1  = t_out$estimate[1],
          estimate2  = t_out$estimate[2],
          statistic  = t_out$statistic,
          p.value    = t_out$p.value,
          conf.low   = t_out$conf.int[1],
          conf.high  = t_out$conf.int[2],
          n_before   = n_before,
          n_after    = n_after
        )
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
})

#sort precincts in ascending order 
results <- results %>% arrange((precinct_crime))
print(results)
#write.csv(results,
#          "/Users/ishika/Desktop/MS/DSAN 5100/Final Project/race_ttest_precincts_top20.csv",
#          row.names = FALSE)

```

# EDA PLOTS

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

top20 <- c(40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 46, 47, 48, 52,
           67, 73, 75, 79, 81, 83, 103, 105, 113, 114, 115)

df_vis <- data %>%
  filter(precinct_crime %in% top20) %>%
  filter(!susp_race %in% c("UNKNOWN", "(null)", "", NA))

```

# Stacked barplot

```{r}
ggplot(df_vis, aes(x = factor(precinct_crime), fill = susp_race)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ time_period, ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Race Composition in Top 20 Precincts (Before vs After Patternizr)",
    x = "Precinct",
    y = "Proportion of Suspects",
    fill = "Suspect Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))

```
